Since 0.1.4. The major version stays 0.

### Play
Switch saves made in Eden sync through RomM (#330). The folder is the one Eden already uses for keys and firmware. Settings › Emulators › Eden calls that row Saves, keys & firmware. A launch that still needs it asks Sync Eden saves?. Play without syncing is for this launch only.

A RomM save Eden cannot place yet stops the launch. Couldn't load the save names the game, and the copy on RomM stays. When Eden has no user yet, open Eden once, then start the game again. Play without syncing starts this one time. Not now, or Back, leaves the game unstarted.

Y › Saves lists Eden's saves.

### Fixes
A save that diverged on two devices, on any emulator, no longer sits on Saves waiting to upload. RomM can ask for the newer copy and then refuse it. Foldcade keeps both, and Two saves asks which one to play (#330).

Switch games no longer read Saves not syncing after Foldcade restarts. When only Eden still needs its folder, the R1 notice opens that picker.

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads exported `.steam` files only. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
